summary: Siskiyou NF tower in Josephine County: dated 1941, staffed 64 days that year, abandoned in the 1940s, marked removed or gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: Tower, per firelookout.com and the FFLA list
facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says it was abandoned in the 1940s. The Oregon list marks it Removed with no date. The FFLA list says Gone.

staffing.status: staffed 64 days in 1941, per the Oregon list

events.note: Firelookout.com lists a tower in 1941, and the Siskiyou list gives 1941 for the site. Neither says whether that year marks construction or first use.
Staffed 64 days; reported to the Redwood Ranger Station (Oregon list).

evidence.supports: staffed 64 days in 1941; reported to the Redwood Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 1941: The lookout staffed 64 days. Reported to the Redwood Ranger Station.

evidence.supports: 1941 entry for Hayward Peak, Josephine County
Oregon list calls it Hayward Mountain

resolved_conflicts.explanation: firelookout.com says abandoned in the 1940s; the Oregon list says removed with no date; the FFLA list says gone. The story reports all three and does not invent a removal date.

sources.title: Oregon Lookouts - Forest Fire Lookout Association

notes_for_editor: Sourcing is thin: no source describes the site today and none gives a removal date. The style column of the Siskiyou list row reads as a fireman's station, which conflicts with the tower design; the PDF text is run together, so check that row by eye. A Josephine County blog page lists several lookouts under a Hayward Mountain heading, with build dates including 1939. None could be tied to this peak with confidence, so none were used. The 1940s abandonment appears only in the status note: no source dates it more finely than the 1940s.
